title: 初一五组十七题：读书伙伴与图书管理员
instruction: 阅读A—E五组中的全部九份文字材料，回答第1至第17题；每题从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最合适的一项。各题2分，共34分。人物与事件均为虚构。
source_notice: 参照既存公开转载合肥三十中2025—2026七上10月卷阅读第一节A—E：A四份人物短介绍、B两封往返信、C一份场所与失物介绍、D个人活动介绍、E介绍另一人物；3/4/4/3/3共17题，各四独立候选，每题2分共34分。原总阅读20题40分另含第二节F三开放题，本稿不恢复开放部分，不称40分整大题。原A下划线未保于公开文字、E反向题未述信息风险及原键未取得分层保留；原校施测未独立认证。本稿所有人物机构、物品与活动虚构，A标粗代词及C标粗语境词在原创新材料明确显示，E反向项由原文明确否定，不把未述直接当错。全部九份文字与17题必须一起读答，不用单篇或固定六题抵数；作者自审不替代独立教研、学生、商用与生产验证。

sections.label: A
units: I am Lily. This is my orange reading bag. I carry library books in **it**. My name is on the front.
Hello, I am Max. My white water bottle is beside my lunch box. The lunch box is blue.
I am Nia. I like green best. My favourite green T-shirt has a little white bird on it.
Hi, I am Owen. Green is my favourite colour, too. I have a green ruler and a black pencil case.

sections.label: B
units:
Dear Ruby,

Our library club is looking for a new animal story to read together. We meet on Thursdays at Hill School. I remember that you read many books about birds. Can you suggest a good one for our group? We need at least two copies so we can share them.

Leo

Dear Leo,

You could try The Little Bird House. It is about two children who build a home for an injured bird. I have two copies, and you can borrow both. I can bring them to your school on Friday after my swimming lesson. Please keep them clean.

Ruby

sections.label: C
units:
Welcome to the school reading room. Six round tables are for students. Near the window is a long brown desk for Mrs Snow. She helps us find books and checks them when we borrow them.

This morning, Jamie found a purple book bag on a chair. Mrs Snow put it on the shelf behind her desk. Inside are two storybooks and a green notebook. A label on the bag says "Class Five" but has no name. If it is yours, come to Mrs Snow after class. When you borrow a book from this room, please **return** it within two weeks.

sections.label: D
units:
I am Mia and I am thirteen. I study in Class Seven. I enjoy stories and films, but my favourite activity is writing stories. I write about small things that happen at home. My brother likes reading my stories, but he does not write any himself.

Friday is my favourite day. I meet two friends at the writing club after school. We read our new work to one another. On Saturdays, I often go swimming with Mum. Swimming is fun, but the writing club is the part of my week I like most.

sections.label: E
units:
This is our new librarian, Mr Lake. He is forty-two years old. His favourite colour is red. He rides his bicycle to school on Mondays and Wednesdays. On Saturdays, he visits his father and they play chess together.

Mr Lake knows where the books are, but he also listens to our suggestions. He has put a small box by his desk for book requests. He does not teach our history class. Ms Wood is our history teacher. We can ask Mr Lake for help whenever we cannot find a book.

questions.stem: A组 · What does the bold word “it” in A1 refer to?
questions.rationale: A：书装在阅读袋中，it回指bag；B：library修饰books，承载物是bag；C：鸟在Nia衣服上，非Lily装书处；D：姓名印袋上，不可把书装姓名里

questions.stem: A组 · What colour is Max’s water bottle?
questions.rationale: A：橙为Lily阅读袋；B：水瓶明确white；C：蓝的是饭盒；D：黑为Owen笔袋

questions.stem: A组 · Which two people like green best?
questions.rationale: A：Nia和Owen均说green为最爱；B：Nia喜欢绿，Max偏好未给；C：仅说袋橙瓶白，未说二人最爱绿；D：Owen喜欢绿，Lily偏好未给

questions.stem: B组 · Where does Leo’s club meet?
questions.rationale: A：故事有受伤鸟，不代表社团在鸟医院；B：Leo信中明确在Hill School见面；C：游泳课是Ruby另一个活动；D：信中未说在Ruby家聚会

questions.stem: B组 · What stories does Leo like reading?
questions.rationale: A：未说棋手故事，更没有only；B：旅途为Ruby偏好；C：Leo明确animal stories；D：游泳在D活动，非Leo阅读偏好

questions.stem: B组 · When can Ruby bring the books?
questions.rationale: A：未说周一送书；B：未说周六送书；C：Ruby回信明确周五游泳课后送书；D：周四为社团见面，不是她可送书日

questions.stem: B组 · Why does Leo write to Ruby?
options: To ask her to suggest a book.
To invite her to a swimming lesson.
To ask her to build a bird house.
To thank her for two returned books.
questions.rationale: A：Leo要适合社团的动物故事，问Ruby推荐；B：Ruby已有游泳课，并非Leo邀请；C：鸟屋为推荐书情节，非实际请求；D：首次请求推荐，不是感谢归还借出书

questions.stem: C组 · What colour is Mrs Snow’s desk?
questions.rationale: A：未说桌白；B：绿为内放笔记本；C：紫为失物袋；D：管理员桌为long brown desk

questions.stem: C组 · Where is the purple bag now?
options: On the shelf behind Mrs Snow’s desk.
questions.rationale: A：找到后放在老师桌后书架；B：未放圆桌下；C：椅为发现处，已移走；D：未让Jamie留在自己包

questions.stem: C组 · What is inside the purple bag?
options: A storybook and two green notebooks.
Two storybooks and a green notebook.
Three storybooks and a green ruler.
Two storybooks and a red notebook.
questions.rationale: A：数量互换不合；B：袋内明确两故事书一绿笔记本；C：书数和物品都错；D：本颜色非红

questions.stem: C组 · What does “return” in C mean in Chinese?
questions.rationale: A：无剪书要求，与归还期限不合；B：借阅不等于购买；C：借出的书两周内交回阅览室，return指归还；D：学生借书无需出版书

questions.stem: D组 · Which class is Mia in?
questions.rationale: A：未说Mia两班；B：未说Mia九班；C：五班为失物袋标签；D：Mia明确七班

questions.stem: D组 · What does Mia like doing best?
questions.rationale: A：喜欢但不是最爱；B：也有趣但写作社是最爱；C：下棋在E管理员和父亲活动；D：她明说最喜欢写故事

questions.stem: D组 · Why does Mia like Friday best?
options: Her brother writes a story for her.
She meets her writing friends at the club.
She plays chess with her father.
questions.rationale: A：兄弟不写故事，明确否定；B：周五与两朋友在写作社交流新作；C：父亲下棋为E管理员情节，非Mia；D：游泳明确周六，非周五

questions.stem: E组 · How does Mr Lake get to school on Mondays?
questions.rationale: A：原文骑车，非步行；B：原文骑车，非火车；C：原文骑车，非公交；D：周一周三骑自行车上学

questions.stem: E组 · Which statement about Mr Lake is NOT true?
options: He plays chess with his father.
questions.rationale: A：最爱红明说；B：周六与父亲下棋明说；C：原明确他不教历史，由Ms Wood教，直接矛盾；D：听取建议并放请求箱明说

questions.stem: E组 · What is the best title for E?
questions.rationale: A：全文围绕新管理员；B：兄弟阅读在D，不是E重点；C：只区分历史老师，非介绍校史；D：E没有游泳课

format_summary: 完整客观第一节A—E / 9份文字 / 响应3+4+4+3+3=17 / 各4选 / 每题2分共34分 / 原第二节开放题暂停
